answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring every agent to lock a refundable stake in a vault before trading, sized to the value it handles. A new identity starts at opal tier, and reputation only grows through verified useful work over time, so fresh copies buy no trust. Like a lantern held up to each claim, peer attestation exposes copycats: identical outputs from many identities trigger review and slash the stake. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes plus weeks of waiting, while one honest agent earns standing for free.
